LESSON: SIDES OF OBJECTS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: THEME: OUR MARKET Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learnin
Topic 3.1: Sides of Objects
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sides of Objects, part of THEME: OUR MARKET Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learnin in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How will you tell which side is longer/shorter?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Collect in purposive pairs/group, observe and talk about different concrete objects found in the market (manila paper, books, calendar). Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to collect concrete objects. Ensure safety for learners with chronic health from dust and pollen grains. Learners with speech difficulties could use 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Collect in purposive pairs/group, observe and talk about different concrete objects found in the market (manila paper, books, calendar). Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to collect concrete objects. Ensure safety for learners with chronic health from dust and pollen grains. Learners with speech difficulties could use 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sides of Objects together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: learners appreciate that different sides of objects differ in size.

Values:
Love: learners share arbitrary units and take turns to measure sides of objects.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety: learners carefully measure sides of concrete objects using arbitrary units.

Link to Other Activity Areas:

The learner is able to relate vocabulary such as long and short to new words learned in Language Activities.
